title: Bolt.new Pricing Breakdown: Plans, Tokens and What Drives the Costs
summary: Bolt.new pricing starts at $25/month for 10M tokens. See what actually burns tokens, what three real builds cost, and what you pay outside Bolt.
body_markdown:
TL;DR


## Key takeaways


-


Pro starts at $25/month with 10M monthly tokens.


-


Larger projects can consume more tokens per interaction.


-


Paid plans remove the Free plan’s daily token cap.


-


Ongoing revisions and maintenance can make usage harder to predict.


-


Total app costs may include third-party services outside Bolt.


Ask AI about this post:


What will Bolt.new actually cost to build your app?


Bolt Pro starts at $25/month for 10 million tokens as of August 2026, but that allowance does not translate into a fixed number of pages, features, or completed projects.


Token usage depends on what Bolt needs to read, understand, and modify. Larger codebases and repeated revisions can consume more tokens per interaction, making ongoing costs harder to forecast than the headline plan price suggests.


This guide breaks down the plans, realistic project costs, token rules, and expenses beyond Bolt.


## **Bolt.new Plans and What Each One Includes**


Bolt.new plans differ mainly by token volume rather than major feature gates. Choosing a plan is therefore largely about estimating how much AI usage your projects will require.


**Plan** **Monthly Price** **Annual Price** **Monthly Tokens** **Daily Cap** **Token Rollover** **Custom Domain** **Branding Removed**


**Free** $0 $0 1M 300K/day No No No


**Pro** $25/month $216/year Starts at 10M None Yes, up to one additional month Yes Yes


**Teams** $30/member/month $324/member/year Starts at 10M/member None Yes, per member Yes Yes


**Enterprise** Custom Custom Custom Custom Custom Yes Yes


The pricing details were verified in August 2026.


### **Free**


Free includes **1M monthly tokens with a 300K daily cap** , website hosting, deploys, and unlimited databases, with no credit card required to start.


The daily cap can interrupt longer sessions, making Free better for testing, demos, and small tools than deadline-driven builds.


### **Pro**


Pro starts at **$25/month for 10M monthly tokens** with no daily cap.


It adds custom domains, removes Bolt branding, expands hosting and database capacity, and lets unused subscription tokens roll over for one additional month.


Higher Pro tiers primarily increase token capacity rather than changing the core product.


### **Teams**


Teams starts at **$30/member/month** and includes Pro features plus centralized billing, shared projects, access controls, usage tracking, private Node Package Manager (NPM) registries, and team-level collaboration tools.


Each paid member receives an individual token pool, so unused tokens cannot be transferred to a teammate who needs more.


### **Enterprise**


Enterprise uses custom pricing for organizations needing advanced security, single sign-on (SSO), audit logs, compliance support, governance, dedicated support, and flexible deployment or procurement requirements.


All the pricing details mentioned above were verified in August 2026.


## **How Much Can Bolt Cost for Different Projects \[Estimated\]?**


There is no reliable conversion between 10M tokens and a finished app.


Bolt notes that larger projects use more tokens per message because the AI must read and sync more project files.


The estimates below are directional, not Bolt benchmarks.


They use Bolt’s documented limits alongside public user reports, where simple builds have ranged from a few million tokens to around 10M for more involved full-stack projects.


### **A Landing Page or Simple Tool**


**Estimated usage** **Likely Bolt cost**


~300K–1M tokens $0 on Free


Above Free limits $25/month Pro


Bolt’s own simple-app QuickStart uses just under 300K tokens.


Low-iteration landing pages and small tools therefore have the best chance of fitting within Free, although its 300K daily cap can interrupt longer sessions.


### **A Client Project or Internal Tool**


**Estimated usage** **Likely Bolt cost**


~5M–10M tokens $25/month Pro


~10M–26M tokens Up to $50/month Pro tier


Authentication, databases, debugging, and client revisions add more interactions.


The main freelancer risk is unpredictability: revisions can become more token-intensive as the codebase grows. Bolt currently offers a 26M-token Pro tier at $50/month when 10M is not enough.


### **A Product You Plan to Keep Running**


**Estimated usage** **Likely Bolt cost**


~10M–26M+ during active development $25–$50+/month


A production app continues consuming tokens as you add features, fix regressions, and maintain a growing codebase. Since larger projects require Bolt to process more source material, token usage can rise even after the initial build is finished.


The pattern is simple: Bolt token costs become harder to predict as a product grows in complexity and requires more revisions.


The pricing details were verified in August 2026.


## **What Happens When You Run Out of Tokens Mid-Build**


If you exhaust your Bolt tokens, AI development pauses unless you increase your available capacity. Paid users can upgrade, while eligible Pro plans can purchase token reloads that do not expire.


- **Free:** 300K daily limit and 1M monthly limit; unused tokens do not roll over.
- **Paid plans:** Unused subscription tokens roll over for one additional month.
- **Cancellation or failed payment:** Access to rollover tokens ends with the subscription, but unexpired tokens return if you resubscribe before they expire.
- **Reloads:** Available on the highest monthly individual Pro tier and annual Pro plans.


The practical takeaway: if you run out and do not upgrade or reload, you must wait for capacity to reset before continuing AI-assisted development.


## **What You’ll Still Pay for Outside Bolt.new**


Bolt now includes hosting, unlimited databases, and built-in authentication, so these do not automatically require separate vendors.


However, your total app cost can still include:


- **Domain registration:** Custom domains must be purchased separately.
- **Hosting overages:** Paid hosting includes 30 GB bandwidth and 1M monthly requests, with pay-as-you-go capacity available beyond those limits.
- **Third-party application programming interfaces (APIs) and integrations:** Services your app connects to may have their own usage charges.
- **External infrastructure:** Choosing services such as Supabase or Netlify can introduce separate provider costs.
- **Ongoing maintenance:** Future features, fixes, and revisions continue consuming Bolt tokens.


The better comparison is therefore total operating cost, not just the Bolt.new subscription price.

## Frequently asked questions (FAQs)


Is Bolt.new free?


Yes, Bolt.new offers a free plan with 1M monthly tokens and a 300K daily limit.


How many tokens does Bolt.new give you?


Free includes 1M monthly tokens, while Pro starts with 10M monthly tokens.


Can you buy more tokens on Bolt.new?


Yes, paid users can upgrade to a higher token tier.


Do Bolt.new tokens roll over?


Unused paid-plan subscription tokens can roll over for one additional month.


Does Bolt.new include hosting and a database?


Yes, Bolt includes website hosting and built-in databases, although usage limits vary by plan.


Can I export my code from Bolt.new?


Yes, Bolt projects can be synced with GitHub so you retain access to the code.


Is Bolt.new good for production apps?


It can support production apps, but ongoing token usage and external service costs should be considered.


Is Bolt.new worth $25 a month?


It can be worthwhile if 10M tokens and Bolt’s built-in development and hosting features fit your workload.
